alt: Two bars show 68 to 69 game days reached in the 120 s per-scenario budget against the promised 992 days (about 4 years), and the 120 s budget against the 1,667 s that 992 days would need per scenario.
caption: The prompt promised about 4 game years per scenario, but the 120 s per-scenario budget covers only 68 to 69 game days, so the score is a snapshot taken early in the game.
